title: Falling cubes
blurb: Turn gravity on and watch three shapes drop onto a floor.

title: All the shapes
blurb: Cube, sphere, cylinder, capsule, cone and torus, dropped from the same height.

title: A tower of cubes
blurb: Friction holds a stack of cubes up. Press Space to blow it over.
hint: Click the picture, then press Space to blow it over.

title: Through the ring
blurb: A small ball falls through a torus; a big one rests on top of it.

title: Walk and jump (WASD + Space)
blurb: A player you steer with WASD, a camera that follows, and a jump only from the ground.
hint: Click the picture, then use W A S D and Space.

title: Joints (a door, a rope, a drawer)
blurb: A hinged door, a rope with a weight and a sliding drawer.
hint: Click the picture, then press Space to shove the drawer.

title: Moving platform and bullets
blurb: A kinematic platform that carries what stands on it, and bullets that never tunnel.

title: Touch verbs
blurb: A sensor zone that colours every ball inside it.

title: Rain (performance)
blurb: Up to 300 falling bodies with the performance panel on.

title: Wrecking ball
blurb: A heavy ball on a rope swings into a wall of cubes, then it all resets.

title: Dominoes
blurb: A curved line of dominoes. Tip the first one and watch it travel.
hint: Click the picture, then press Space.

title: Bowling
blurb: Ten pins and a heavy ball. Aim, roll and set up again.
hint: Click the picture. Left and right aim, Space rolls, R resets.

title: Turntable
blurb: A small still life with shadows. Drag to walk the camera around it.
hint: Drag with the mouse over the picture.
